create_truncation_noise_widget: create a TruncationNoiseWidget instance with a viz object to control truncation and noise settings in the StyleNeRf GUI
configure_truncation_psi: configure the truncation psi slider to adjust truncation strength between -1 and 2 for StyleNeRf generation
set_truncation_cutoff: set the truncation cutoff value to control which latent layers are truncated during StyleNeRf synthesis
toggle_noise_settings: toggle noise enable checkbox and set noise seed to control random noise injection in StyleNeRf output
reset_widget_defaults: reset the TruncationNoiseWidget to default values with psi=1, cutoff=num_ws, noise enabled, seed=0, and anim disabled
